messages:
Morgan Lee: Quick heads-up — company all-hands this Friday 10:00am PT. Agenda preview:
- 20m: Product deep-dive — serving runtime optimizations + live batching demo
- 10m: Hiring update & interviewer rubric changes
- 10m: Ops spotlight — Dedicated rollout timeline and beta plan
- 10m: Q&A (live + pre-submitted)
Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/ah-0415  — please add any questions below or drop them in #all-hands-questions. Recording + notes will be posted after the meeting.

Alexa Santos: I can demo the continuous batching change and show before/after p50/p95. Can we carve out 5m for a short live qps run? :eyes:

Raj Patel: Quick ask — will the hiring update cover IC leveling (specifically L3/L4 expectations)?

Carmen Ortiz: FYI: if you reference customers in slides, mark the prep as internal-only and avoid PII. Put any sensitive Qs in the private doc I shared.

Jonah Kim: Can we get a preread deck by Thursday EOD? I’ll need it to prepare a couple of infra questions.

SRE Bot: Reminder — maintenance window Fri 9:30–9:45 PT. All-hands starts after the window; rolling deploys paused during the meeting. :robot_face:

People Ops: On hiring — we’ll cover the updated interviewer scorecard and a timeline for rolling out panel training. Interviewers, please complete the new unconscious-bias microlearning by Friday.

Morgan Lee: Thanks — Alexa/Jonah I’ll schedule a 10m dry run Wed at 11am PT. Raj, yes we’ll touch on leveling changes. Carmen noted on the doc. If you post a pre-submitted Q please prefix with `Q:` so we can triage the queue.

Alexa Santos: Dropping a note — I’ll attach the perf slides and a short runbook for the demo in the shared folder by Thu noon.

(Thursday evening) Morgan Lee: Final reminder — slides due by Thu EOD. If you need AV help ping @aaron (AV lead) in #eng.

(Friday 11:20am PT) Morgan Lee: All-hands finished — posting recording and notes now. Recording: https://drive.redwood.example/ah-0415-recording  Notes + action items: https://docs.redwood.example/ah-0415-notes
TL;DR / takeaways:
1) Runtime: Prefix/KV caching and continuous batching decreased token cost by ~18% on sampled workloads (slides + bench attached).
2) Dedicated: Beta onboarding starts mid-May; first wave limited to 3 customers, SLA details in notes.
3) Hiring: Headcount request approved for 12 ICs for Q3; new interviewer rubric rolled out, People Ops to run two training cohorts.
4) Ops: On-call rota changes — eng leads to update by Apr 22; SRE to publish new escalation doc.
5) Action items: Alexa to upload raw bench logs; Raj to sync with People Ops on leveling language; Carmen to publish internal guidance for customer mentions.

Alexa Santos: Slides & raw bench logs here: https://drive.redwood.example/ah-0415/slides.pdf and https://drive.redwood.example/ah-0415/bench-logs.tar.gz

Raj Patel: Q from the session — will prefix caching be opt-in per customer or default-on for hosted?

Morgan Lee: Answer: For hosted customers we’re default-on with opt-out via org settings. For Dedicated we’ll leave it configurable during beta.

Carmen Ortiz: People Ops will open a hiring Q&A doc for follow-ups and FAQ.

Jonah Kim: Great session — nice demos. Thanks everyone :clap:

People Ops: Thanks all — we’ll post the training sign-up links in #people-ops tomorrow.

Morgan Lee: Appreciate the turnout. If you weren’t able to join, please review the notes & add follow-up Qs in the doc. I’ll follow up with a short postcard of action items tomorrow.
